description: Box and Shape: a row of tone swatches (shares of the row, a fill and a border in a tone), a timeline with a canvas of bars per row, and a gauge, a triangle and a polyline in a row.

events.text:
```neoui
<Stack>
  <Text>A **swatch row**, a timeline and some shapes, built from `Box` and `Shape`</Text>
  <Box dir="row" gap="s" pad="none" width="fill">
    <Box dir="column" pad="s" width={0.25} fill="accent" border="accent" rounded><Text>accent</Text></Box>
    <Box dir="column" pad="s" width={0.25} fill="muted" border="muted"><Text>muted</Text></Box>
    <Box dir="column" pad="s" width={0.25} fill="success"><Text>success</Text></Box>
    <Box dir="column" pad="s" width={0.25} border="danger"><Text>danger</Text></Box>
  </Box>
  <Box dir="column" gap="none" pad="s" width="fill" border="muted" rounded>
    <Box dir="row">
      <Box dir="column" width={0.2}><Text>Design</Text></Box>
      <Box dir="column" width={0.8}><Shape kind="rect" points={[0, 0, 0.35, 1]} tone="accent" fill aspect={16}/></Box>
    </Box>
    <Box dir="row">
      <Box dir="column" width={0.2}><Text>Build</Text></Box>
      <Box dir="column" width={0.8}><Shape kind="rect" points={[0.3, 0, 0.5, 1]} tone="success" fill aspect={16}/></Box>
    </Box>
    <Box dir="row">
      <Box dir="column" width={0.2}><Text>Ship</Text></Box>
      <Box dir="column" width={0.8}>
        <Shape kind="rect" points={[0.75, 0, 0.2, 1]} tone="danger" fill={false} aspect={16}/>
        <Shape kind="line" points={[0.75, 0.5, 0.95, 0.5]} tone="danger" fill={false} aspect={16}/>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  </Box>
  <Box dir="row" gap="m">
    <Box dir="column" width={0.25}>
      <Shape kind="arc" points={[0.5, 0.5, 0.45, 0, 1]} tone="muted" fill={false} aspect={1}/>
      <Shape kind="arc" points={[0.5, 0.5, 0.45, 0, 0.72]} tone="accent" fill aspect={1}/>
    </Box>
    <Box dir="column" width={0.25}>
      <Shape kind="path" points={[0.5, 0.05, 0.95, 0.95, 0.05, 0.95]} tone="danger" fill aspect={1}/>
    </Box>
    <Box dir="column" width={0.4}>
      <Shape kind="line" points={[0, 0.8, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.6, 0.6, 0.1, 0.8, 0.5, 1, 0.2]} tone="success" fill={false} aspect={1}/>
    </Box>
  </Box>
</Stack>
```
